name: superduperbird
description: Spotify Car Thing (superbird): nd-0r/superduperbird-buildroot, a BR2_EXTERNAL tree on Buildroot 2024.05
notes: Two deviations from the project's defconfig, applied to every build we compare (golden included): (1) post_image.sh writes into $BR2_EXTERNAL/output and loop-mounts an image, incompatible with the read-only fixed-path namespace; (2) the pinned HEAD commit ('Still trying to get Amlogic's code to compile') fails to build the kernel with board/linux.config (CONFIG_AMLOGIC_MEDIA_VIDEOCAPTURE unset -> implicit declaration in video.c), so the older full config linux.config.4.9.113 is used. (3) the default defconfig lacks the DTS settings that external.mk's hook needs (superbird_evt_512.dtb); they are taken from superduperbird_dev_defconfig. (4) /etc/shadow is compared by presence only: the sha-256 root password hash gets a random salt on every build, golden or not.
